text:
lena: Customer steering committee meeting: they want a single-page operator deliverable (PDF) from our preflight + a deterministic rollback contract clause. They also asked that the preflight include a one-line remediation code they can hand to netops.

harry: what do they mean by remediation code? short ID we can map to a KB article?

lena: exactly. e.g., RMD-443-EGRESS -> "enable outbound 443 to control or enable relay". They want codes because their ticketing system can auto-route by code.

michael: ok. proposed preflight outputs:
- human report (1 page) PASS/WARN/FAIL per check + remediation code + 1-line hint
- compact manifest (JSON) with non-identifying fields only
- PDF export signed with our CI PGP key + installer HMAC included

sofia: manifest fields we can include: installer_hmac, agent_semver, kernel_major, bgp_requested (true/false), outbound_443 (PASS/FAIL), relay_tls (PASS/FAIL), telemetry_opt_in (true/false), consent_timestamp (UTC). Nothing with host IPs.

harry: add also a tiny failure_code list in the manifest: [RMD-443-EGRESS, RMD-BGP-MISSING]. That helps automation.

lena: good. legal wants explicit attestation wording in the PDF and a signed operator checkbox. sample: "I, the installing operator, attest that the environment checked below is under my control and consent to anonymized manifest sharing with Redwood for support." checkbox + name + UTC iso timestamp.

ops-bot: NOTE: ticket ONRAMP-9001 created for preflight+pdf PoC, assigned to michael. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/onramp/ONRAMP-9001

michael: Preflight CLI idea: `./rwi-onramp-preflight --control https://control.redwood.io --checks egress,cert,relay,bgp --emit-manifest --sign-pdf`. It emits `preflight.txt`, `manifest.json`, and `preflight.pdf.asc`.

sofia: UX: console shows compact card with status pill + remediation codes collapsed. PDF download and manifest JSON available; also a copy-to-clipboard for remediation codes. Compliance can auto-ingest manifest JSON endpoint if customer opts in.

lena: upgrade lanes discussion: customer demanded deterministic limits: minor patch = max 2 node restarts; major = manual and scheduled. Fast lane requirements: preflight PASS, relay enabled, signed operator ack. Fast lane rollback MTTR target: <= 15m. Cautious lane MTTR <= 60m.

harry: define rollback exactly: staged rollout with canary window (10%), then 30min observation, then 50% then final. Auto-halt if health-check error > 4% or control-plane error spike >6% sustained 5m. On auto-halt we revert via snapshot+config rollback. Provide a force-rollback CLI for operators.

michael: propose downtime budget concept: customer picks a max allowed aggregate restart time during patch (e.g., 10 minutes total). If exceeded, auto-halt and rollback. We'll expose this as `--downtime-budget` in the rollout API.

sofia: air-gap handling: preflight will run offline checks and produce manifest + PDF; installer HMAC included but PGP proof can be verified out-of-band. Relay and automatic fast lane not available for air-gapped installs; cautious lane only.

legal: confirm consent wording must be stored in manifest and PDF with signature. Also include CI artifact URL and HMAC for chain-of-custody. We'll draft contract clause.

lena: acceptance criteria to present to the customer:
- one-page preflight PDF with remediation codes + signed operator attestation
- manifest JSON schema (non-identifying fields) + CI-signed HMAC proof published
- console card + download flow implemented + copyable remediation codes
- upgrade lanes + downtime-budget feature documented and tested in lab (fast/cautious)
- air-gap runbook for cautious-only installs

michael: I'll drop a PoC binary and sample PDF in this thread within 72h.

harry: I'll draft the remediation code list and KB mapping.

sofia: I'll wire a compact console card mock and an API endpoint for manifest ingestion.

lena: thanks team. if we can show the PoC and a sample signed PDF we can close the contract clause review next week. :thumbsup:
